subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native `sessions_spawn` expose the optional per-run `announceTarget: "parent"` contract with fail-closed requester-session delivery and no configuration default?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it adds a durable model-facing routing capability and intentionally changes where completion output goes when selected; repository history does not show maintainer acceptance of that permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve per-spawn routing
options.body: Accept only the explicit per-spawn `"parent"` option, retain omission as the current parent-first behavior, and require the checksum repair before merge.

options.title: Defer the new contract
options.body: Close or pause the PR while keeping the linked feature issue open for a different orchestration API or broader routing design.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn routing
recommendation.body: Accept only the explicit per-spawn `"parent"` option, retain omission as the current parent-first behavior, and require the checksum repair before merge.
